name: Fast Fuzzy Search – Lightning-Fast WordPress Search
author: Khizar Hasan

sections.description:
Fast Fuzzy Search enhances your WordPress site by enabling instant fuzzy search for post titles, categories, and attributes. Unlike third-party search services, it’s completely self-hosted, ensuring your data remains private and secure. With a focus on performance and simplicity, Fast Fuzzy Search delivers an intuitive search experience without the need for API integration or external accounts.

🔗 Live Demo | 🔥 Get Pro Version

Why Choose Fast Fuzzy Search?
– Fully self-hosted with no external server requirements
– Optimized for up to 50,000 posts
– AJAX-based front-end for instant results
– Supports WooCommerce and Polylang (Latin script languages)
– Simple shortcode integration for easy setup
– Free core plugin with optional premium styles and custom integrations

Key Features

  • Instant Fuzzy Search: Get search results as you type.
  • AJAX-Powered: Smooth, real-time search without page reloads.
  • Unlimited Records and Queries: No restrictions on search volume.
  • Customizable Themes: Use prebuilt themes or request custom integration.
  • Supports WooCommerce: Enhance your e-commerce store’s search experience.
  • Polylang Compatibility: Works with Latin/Roman script languages for multilingual sites.
  • Privacy First: 100% data remains on your server, ensuring full control.

Comparison with Algolia

Performance (10k–50k Posts)
– Fast Fuzzy Search: Optimized for up to 50,000 posts. But supports unlimited posts depending on the server speed.
– Algolia: Scalable beyond 50,000 posts.

Hosting
– Fast Fuzzy Search: Fully self-hosted (no external dependency).
– Algolia: Requires external Algolia servers.

Search Scope
– Fast Fuzzy Search: Post titles, categories, and attributes.
– Algolia: Full-text search (content, custom fields, etc.).

Customization
– Fast Fuzzy Search: Prebuilt themes + custom integration available.
– Algolia: Fully customizable via API.

Multilingual Support
– Fast Fuzzy Search: Supports Latin script languages (Polylang-compatible).
– Algolia: Full multilingual search with advanced language support.

Cost
– Fast Fuzzy Search: Core plugin is free. Premium styles and custom integration is available.
– Algolia: Paid service with usage-based pricing.

Ease of Use
– Fast Fuzzy Search: Simple installation, no external account needed.
– Algolia: Requires API setup and configuration.

Privacy
– Fast Fuzzy Search: 100% data stays on your server.
– Algolia: Data stored and processed on external servers.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the fast-fuzzy-search folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Add the [fast_fuzzy_search] shortcode to any page or post to display the search form.
sections.faq:
How do I use the plugin?

Simply use the [fast_fuzzy_search] shortcode wherever you want the search form to appear.

Can I customize the search results?

Currently, the plugin supports default customization via setting page. Additional features can be added in future updates.

Does this plugin work with custom post types?

Yes, it fully supports all public custom post types.
